output.subject: We have received your complaint about calls to your number
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm what you have told us.

You mentioned that you are not a Meridian Harbor Bank customer, yet for about a month you have been receiving calls about a past-due auto loan for someone you do not know. You told us that you have explained to our callers at least five times that this is the wrong number, and that the calls have continued anyway. You also told us that during yesterday's call, the caller shared details about that person's debt, which you feel you should not have been told. You have asked us to take your number off our call list and to stop the calls.

We're sorry to hear about the frustration you've described. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint, including your request about the calls, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for taking the time to let us know.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Complainant states they are not a customer; confirm there is no relationship before replying.
Sign-off is split across two name tokens; confirm the correct name to use in the greeting.
Customer asked for written contact; confirm the reply address, since no postal address appears in the complaint.
Decide whether the number can be removed from the call list now, ahead of the full response.
Customer reports a caller disclosed another person's debt details; this needs review before any substantive reply.
Customer reports at least five earlier wrong-number reports that went unactioned; check call records.
